# modules.ModuleSettings

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Settings of one installed module in an organization; values follow the module's own settings contract.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `modules.ModuleSettings` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `moduleId` | yes | `none` | Module the settings belong to. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization the settings belong to. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the values last changed (UTC); null until first saved. |  |
| `updatedBy` | yes | `personal` | Actor id of the last editor (uid, device id or API key id); null until first saved. |  |
| `values` | yes | `personal` | Values validated by the module's settings contract; null until first saved. |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
